verdict.rationale: v0's Platform API docs explicitly claim programmatic access to all of v0's capabilities, including code generation, chat, project management and deployment. GitHub repository imports, export, custom chat UIs and an official SDK (`v0.chats.create`, API-key/OIDC auth) back this up. However, the evidence lists only a subset of UI features as API-accessible, and nothing independent confirms that parity holds. Missing for 10: API evidence for UI-only features such as visual fine-tuning controls, design-system/style definitions and Fix CI/Fix Conflicts branch actions, plus independent or hands-on confirmation of full UI parity.
